Add the county drought class to field-periods

Source: R/analysis.R
fpc_add_drought.Rd

Joins the US Drought Monitor map that was valid on each date (the map whose week contains the first day of the 5-day period) of the field's county.

Usage

fpc_add_drought(x, dir = NULL)

Arguments

x

A data frame with field_id and date, such as the output of fpc_composites().

dir

Data folder. Defaults to fpc_dir().

Value

x with the columns usdm_class (0 none, 1 D0, 2 D1, 3 D2, 4 D3, 5 D4: the highest category that covers at least half of the county), usdm_d1_pct (percent of the county in D1 or worse) and dsci (Drought Severity and Coverage Index, 0-500).

Examples

d <- fpc_example_dir()
x <- fpc_composites(vars = "ndvi", years = 2022, dir = d)
x <- fpc_add_drought(x, dir = d)
table(x$usdm_class)
#> 
#>   0   1   2 
#> 460  68 129
